meta.name: proprietary-data-generator
meta.description: Create original surveys, benchmarks, and aggregated data nobody else has. Automate data collection for content moats. Triggers on: "create original data", "proprietary data", "survey design", "benchmark study", "original research", "data-driven content", "create a survey", "industry benchmark", "aggregated data", "unique data", "first-party data", "data moat", "generate research data", "create a study", "original statistics", "data nobody else has", "competitive data advantage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成独家调查、基准数据和聚合数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要独特数据建立内容护城河
copy.tagline_en: Generate unique surveys, benchmarks, and aggregated data automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need proprietary data to build a content moat

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计并执行原创数据收集方案，包括调查、基准研究、数据聚合等，用于生成独家内容护城河。它会分析市场数据缺口，产出可复用的数据资产。
howto.when: 当你提到“创建原创数据”、“专有数据”或“调查设计”等关键词，或要求做调查、行业基准时触发。也适用于 content-moat-calculator 识别出需要差异化内容后。

say.text: 帮我设计一份关于AI视频工具的原创调查。
say.note: Claude 会产出调查问题、分发计划和内容策略。

say.text: 做一份联盟营销行业收入基准报告。
say.note: Claude 会提供数据聚合方案和自动化采集流程。

say.text: 找一个人人都想要但没人有数据的角度。
say.note: Claude 会搜索数据缺口，设计独家数据资产。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design and execute original data collection plans (surveys, benchmarks, aggregations) to generate proprietary data assets that competitors cannot replicate. It identifies data gaps, creates collection assets, and sets up automation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "create original data", "proprietary data", "survey design", or ask for surveys/benchmarks. Also after content-moat-calculator identifies a need for differentiated content.

say_en.text: Design an original survey about AI video tools.
say_en.note: Claude outputs questions, distribution plan, and content strategy.

say_en.text: Create a benchmark report on affiliate marketing earnings.
say_en.note: Claude provides aggregation method and automation schedule.

say_en.text: Find a data angle nobody else has covered.
say_en.note: Claude searches for gaps and proposes a unique data asset.
